    var _client = try liter_llm.create_client(std.mem.span(_api_key), null, null, null, null);
    defer _client.free();
    const _result_json = try _client.chat("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"my-auth-model-v1\"}");
